rules.target: liver ultrasound surveillance every 6-12 months for at least 5 years, with liver MRI if any suspicious finding is detected
rules.source_span: In low-risk patients, liver US every 6-12 months for ≥5 years is recommended; liver MRI should be scheduled if any suspicious finding is detected [III, A].
In high-risk patients, liver MRI is recommended every 4-6 months for ≥10 years [III, A].

refusals.reason_text: The applicability condition requires HLA genotype status, which has no corresponding variable in the schema (only has_metastatic and on_tebentafusp exist). Additionally, the recommendation carries an exception for cases where liver-directed debulking is required first, a clinical-judgement condition that is likewise unrepresentable, making the rule defeasible and unencodable as stated.
refusals.source_span: For HLA-A∗02:01-positive patients, tebentafusp should be standard of care in the first-line metastatic setting unless liver-directed treatment modalities are required first for tumour debulking
undefined_predicates: liver-directed treatment modalities are required first for tumour debulking
evidence: Only has_metastatic and on_tebentafusp are available; HLA status and line-of-therapy are unbound.

refusals.reason_text: The recommendation specifies a recurring, phase-changing surveillance schedule (6-monthly examinations for an imprecise 2-5 year period, then transitioning to annual examinations). The DSL can only express a single elapsed-time-since-event predicate and cannot represent a repeating interval schedule, nor the indeterminate 2-5 year switch point at which the interval changes. There is also no anchor event for the start of follow-up.
refusals.source_span: Patients should receive routine ophthalmologic examinations every 6 months for 2-5 years, then annually
undefined_predicates: every 6 months for 2-5 years, then annually

refusals.reason_text: The applicability conditions rely on concepts with no corresponding variable in the DSL (only 'biopsy' is available), and both are undefined/unmeasurable predicates: whether the clinical diagnosis is uncertain, and whether a shared-decision discussion about procedural risks occurred. Neither can be bound to a schema variable or given a stated threshold.
refusals.source_span: A biopsy is recommended if the clinical diagnosis is uncertain and if it has been discussed with the patient due to the potential risks of the procedure and the uncertainty of a conclusive result [II, A].
undefined_predicates: it has been discussed with the patient
evidence: Only the variable/event 'biopsy' exists in the schema enums; no variable represents diagnostic uncertainty or patient discussion.
